profile.headline: Software Engineer at Federal Reserve Bank

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented TDF (Term Deposit Facility) 
Web-base application that is used by all of the Federal Reserve Banks to collect, analyze and monitor financial data from the nation’s commercial depository institutions.Designed and implemented Reporting Central Web-based application that is used by Federal Reserve Banks as a central report entry interface.

company.name: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
•	Developed the technical design and general framework used in Ecommerce Applications such as order capture, order fulfillment, Inventory, Packing and Shipping.
•	Developed JSP pages using Struts with JavaScript validation.
•	Capture order by converting EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) to XML.
•	Create technical system documentation and ensure that this documentation remains current throughout all phases of the SDLC.
•	Developed Struts Action Classes to route the submittals to the Database layer.
•	Wrote Hibernate and SQL queries.
•	Developed test case scenarios for Functional Testing and Integration Testing.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I had worked as a Designer and a lead at ATT. My role was detail designed , developed Client Server system with latest Web environment and components, JNLP based client interact with Java/J2EE, and coordinated with client team and other groups, production support for the development applications.

•	Designed & Developed the Client-Server system (FTT – Field Test Tool) with the latest Web environment and components, JNLP based client interact with Java, Servlet/JSP, JQuery, Oracle JDBC, and produced loadable Excel UTF-8 csv files.
•	AT&T Wireless Performance Data Processing.
•	Implemented a process for large scale events to analyze and report Cellular Hands-off operation failure reasons.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented on functionality to read meters, detect power outages, and connect/disconnect switches remotely by using Java, JDBC, JSP, J2EE.
•	Implemented on a Peak Time Rebate program, which automatically award rebates to customers for reducing energy usage on critical days by using Java, JDBC, JSP, CSS with JavaScript validation.
•	Developed the Java program to create XML file and extract data from the XML.
•	Developed JSP pages using Struts with JavaScript validation.
•	Developed Action Classes to route to different pages, to the database layer and retrieve information. 
•	Wrote SQL script to create table and insert data into tables.
•	Supported QA team to ensure defect analysis, bug fixes.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed both front end and back for new reports using Java, JDBC, JSP, Servlets on Eclipse, and using C# to create GUI to allow users to setup properties on MS Dot Net.
•	Developed JSP pages using Struts as the web-container framework with JavaScript validation.
•	Developed Action Classes to route to different pages, to the database layer and retrieve information.
•	Designed and developed of user interface utilizing JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for internet based front-end.
•	Developed the Java program to create XML file and extract data from the XML.
•	Wrote SQL Scripts to create tables, and wrote SQL procedure to insert lot of data into table.
•	Participated in code walk-though, code review and debugging.
•	Supported QA team to ensure defect analysis, bug fixes.
•	Using Tomcat as a web server.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Earlier I was with SBC, Nortel and 3Com/Palm, S3 Inc . My responsibilities include designed and implemented an application to provide appointment control, technician schedule maintenance and automated job monitoring routines  with Java Swing, JDBC, Oracle Pro*C ; customized Portal Infranet; detail designed API for Palm SDK and Palm Conduit, designed test harness to test every single Palm’s AP;, and developed video driver for S3’s video card by using C/C++.
